feeds.title: Chuck Gallagher Blog
feeds.description: Chuck Gallagher's Business Ethics Blog features his insightful perspective on current events, business news, and other topics as they relate to ethical behavior.

feeds.title: Pilant's Business Ethics Blog
feeds.description: My intent with this blog is to build a site where someone can go and find good up-to-date topical business ethics writing. I also want to get my thoughts out into the great marketplace of ideas. The long term intent is to build a network of business ethics writers who as an interacting group will have an effect on policy.

feeds.title: The Corporate Social Responsibility and Business Ethics Blog
feeds.description: The Corporate Social Responsibility and Business Ethics Blog is devoted to promoting analysis and discussion of corporate social responsibility and business ethics issues around the world. This blog focus on topics such as Law, Business, Social Science, and Policy.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Ethical business
feeds.description: The Guardian's coverage about the topic of ethical business. Stay up to date with the most recent news.

feeds.title: The Business Ethics Blog
feeds.description: A blog about Business Ethics by Chris MacDonald, Ph.D. Chris is a writer, speaker, and consultant on ethics. A philosopher by training, he teaches at Ryerson University's Ted Rogers School of Management, and is a Nonresident Senior Fellow at Duke University's Kenan Institute for Ethics. He is co-editor of the Business Ethics Journal Review.

feeds.title: Business Ethics Highlights
feeds.description: Business Ethics Highlights bring you the day's business news as it relates to business ethics. They also occasionally post links to professional and scholarly conferences related to business ethics and jobs in the field. They feature Business Ethics News, Curated by Chris McDonald & Alexei Marcoux.

feeds.title: Business Ethics
feeds.description: Business Ethics is an online magazine with a strong heritage in the fields of ethics, governance, corporate responsibility, and socially responsible investing. The mission of Business Ethics is to promote ethical business practices and to serve that growing community of professionals and individuals striving to work and invest in responsible ways. They seek to do that by offering their readers information, opinions, and cutting-edge analysis about business and the intersection of business and society.

feeds.title: Business Ethics Case Analyses
feeds.description: Follow this blog for articles about Business Ethics and much more. Individualism (Friedman's Economic Theory), Utilitarianism, Kantianism, and Virtue Theory Analyses of Business Controversies.
